item: the LFO start quantum of a connected lfo modulator (05 "(measure) captures" 1)

candidates.description: the shared worklet rule (worklet.rs, stage 7): the lfo, connected at the pause frame, runs process() from the first quantum whose currentTime is strictly past the float32 begin (worklet::started), its phase set there from ffrac(time * frequency + phaseoffset); the connected gain or pan takes the sample-accurate path from the pause frame
the lfo starts one quantum earlier (started(currentTime + 128 / sr, begin)), everything else unchanged
the lfo starts one quantum later (started(currentTime - 128 / sr, begin))

outcome: outcome (a): the shared rule nulls every case bit for bit; worklet.rs is unchanged and no worklet micro case is re-checked. The Chromium refs were generated once (engine:refs --write); bus-bmod has no lfo (its candidates only move the other cases)
method: the candidates were measured by patching lfo.rs's start test in a scratch build and running micro.rs against the committed refs; the patch is not committed
